newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA TO HOST 2ND BALTIC TRANSIT SEMINAR.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA TO HOST 2ND BALTIC TRANSIT SEMINAR.

text.p: Latvia will host the second Baltic transit business seminar on May 21-22 aimed at tackling existing problems and creating more contacts, the transport ministry said on Wednesday.

Baltic Transit Gateway '97 seminar is expected to gather some 250 participants from Russian and Kazakh oil tansport firms and Western logistics companies, Zigmar Priede, the head of the transit division of the Latvian transport ministry, told Reuters.
The Latvian port of Ventspils will host the second day of the seminar.
Ventspils is the leading gateway for Russia's crude and oil products in the region.
Some 25 percent of Latvia's gross domestic product (GDP) is derived from transit, Priede said.
He added that by July Latvia plans to have a new customs law in place to smooth the administration of transit operations.
The seminar is a follow-up to the TransRussia logistics event earlier this year in Moscow, the organisers said.
